patch.value: Fix daily release ordering so npm publish no longer races ahead of the protected main push

The release workflow published to npm before pushing the version bump to the protected main branch. Branch protection rejected git push origin HEAD:main with GH006 and set -e killed the job before the tag push, leaving npm at 2026.8.10 while main stayed at 2026.8.7 with no v2026.08.10 tag. Port the protected-PR merge flow from pm-context so main is advanced through a rebase PR before npm publish, and improve the merge wait to attempt the merge directly instead of polling mergeStateStatus, which deadlocked on BLOCKED with an empty statusCheckRollup.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Root cause: release.yml published to npm then pushed HEAD:main and the tag in one set -e block. main is protected so HEAD:main is rejected with GH006 and the tag push never runs, leaving npm ahead of git. Fix: merge the release metadata through a protected rebase PR before publishing, verify the merged commit, then publish with an idempotence guard and push the tag only. The merge wait attempts the merge directly and lets GitHub be the authority, resolving unresolved review threads first so advisory bot comments do not block required_conversation_resolution.

patch.value: Release workflow rewritten to merge release metadata through a protected rebase PR before npm publish, verify the merged commit, then publish with an idempotence guard and push the tag only. The merge wait attempts the merge directly via the GitHub merge API instead of polling mergeStateStatus, resolving unresolved review threads before each attempt.
Release workflow merges release metadata through a protected rebase PR before npm publish, verifies the merged commit, then publishes with an idempotence guard and pushes the tag only
A daily release advances main through a protected PR, publishes to npm only after the merge is verified, and pushes the release tag; a previously published version reconciles instead of failing
